x: Pat Parker was placed third in the 3 miles (14:28.0) and earned selection against France the following week. Don Brown was third and Percy Wright fourth in the 2 miles walk, and Eddie Pack (49.2) finished fourth in the final of the 440 yards.
Congratulations also to Eddie Pack upon his selection to represent England at Dublin. A few years ago Pack's times would have won A.A.A. titles.
